question: Pankaj Advani received the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna in 2006. He is associated with which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Billiards and Snooker**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pankaj Advani** is an internationally renowned Indian player in the field of **Billiards and Snooker**. He has made significant contributions to this sport, earning him numerous accolades.
 
• He was honored with the prestigious **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**, India’s highest sporting award, in the year **2006**, which recognizes outstanding achievements by sportspersons.
 
• Advani has an exceptional record in both **English Billiards** and **Snooker**, making him one of the few players to excel in both formats of cue sports. His achievements include multiple world titles in these disciplines.
 
• He is the only cueist in the world to have achieved a unique feat of winning the **World and Asian Championships in both Billiards and Snooker** formats.
 
• His exemplary career and dedication to the sport have made him a role model for aspiring players in India and around the globe.
